a11y.focusedTrunk: {part}. Arrow keys move around the tree, Enter taps.
a11y.menuOpen: {count} things can grow here. Arrow keys choose, Enter grows.
a11y.menuOpenOne: One thing can grow here. An arrow key chooses it, Enter grows it.
a11y.nothingHere: Nothing can grow from this limb yet.
app.canvasHelp: Arrow keys move between limbs. Enter taps the limb and opens what it can grow. Escape closes. Plus and minus zoom, 0 reframes.
app.title: Old Growth
away.capped: — you were gone {duration}, and the tree can only carry on for so long alone
away.quiet: The tree held its ground. Grow some roots and they will keep working while you are gone.
away.title: While you were away
daylight.desc: Leaves make Light from sunlight. The canopy follows the sun up and back down again.
daylight.dewHint: The first tap of each new day shakes the Dew loose.
daylight.moonlit: After dark the canopy keeps a ×{fraction} moonlight trickle. The roots do not care what time it is.
daylight.title: {phase} — day {day}
dock.graftTitle: Graft ({key}) — join two limbs of different species into a hybrid
dock.growTitle: Grow ({key}) — upgrades, taps and the tree itself
dock.journalTitle: Journal ({key}) — species, hybrids and the help pages
dock.label: Tools and panels
dock.pruneTitle: Prune ({key}) — cut a limb for Sap and Deadwood
dock.symbiontsTitle: Symbionts ({key}) — the creatures living in your tree
dock.vaultTitle: Seed Vault ({key}) — Heirlooms, the Old Growth forest, and Go to Seed
dock.vaultTitleGrowing: Seed Vault ({key}) — {percent}% grown. Go to Seed opens at full maturity.
graft.undiscovered: Nobody has grown this before. Graft it to find out what it does.
grow.sheetEmpty: Nothing will grow from this limb yet.
growOption.noVein: No vein here — this tip would find no Minerals. Try another root.
growOption.shaded: Already shaded — the canopy above would take part of this leaf's light.
growOption.structural: Structural — grow leaves or roots on it to produce.
help.lede: A tree is a slow argument between what is above the ground and what is below it. This is everything it knows how to do.
hydration.capped: Capped at ×{max}. The surplus Water is going spare — grow more canopy.
hydration.desc: The roots water the canopy. Light, and the Sap a tap is worth, are both multiplied by this.
hydration.floored: Floored at ×{min}. Grow roots — the canopy is running dry.
hydration.nothingDrinking: Nothing is drinking yet. Grow a leaf cluster.
hydration.title: Hydration ×{value}
journal.footer: Graft (G) two adjacent branches of different species — each carrying something of its own — to make a hybrid. {count} grafts so far.
journal.footerOne: Graft (G) two adjacent branches of different species — each carrying something of its own — to make a hybrid. 1 graft so far.
journal.title: Journal
leaf.blossomCap: Already carrying {count} blossoms — more nearby add nothing.
leaf.buried: Buried. This cluster is down to its floor — spread the canopy out.
leaf.crowded: Crowded. Leaves out in the open catch far more than leaves stacked up.
leaf.desc: Catches sunlight. What it earns depends on how much sky it can still see.
leaf.title: Leaf Cluster
prune.apical: This is the tree's leader. Cutting it wakes every bud below — Lateral Surge for {seconds}s: growth −{discount}% and Sap +{discount}%.
prune.notApical: Cutting the highest point of the tree instead would trigger Lateral Surge.
prune.title: Cut this limb
save.brokenBody: The tree it described could not be rebuilt, so this run starts fresh.
save.notOurs: That does not look like an Old Growth save.
save.recoveredBody: The last save was damaged, so the one before it was opened instead.
save.unrebuildable: The save could not be rebuilt into a tree.
season.ringHint: A ring is laid down for every winter the tree comes through. There is no other way to earn one.
season.title: {season} — year {year}
season.winterHint: Come through to the far side of this and the trunk lays down a ring — a permanent ×{multiplier} on everything it makes.
settings.fontScaleNote: Scales every word in the interface. The tree, the numbers on it and the canvas keep their own size.
settings.hardResetNote: Everything goes: the tree, the Seeds, the Vault, the Journal, the forest. There is no undo.
settings.hintsCleared: Cleared — the game will explain itself.
settings.hintsNote: Contextual bubbles appear once each, when the thing they are about first becomes possible. The Journal’s Help tab has all of it in one place, whenever you want it.
settings.hintsStayNote: Off, a bubble clears itself after a few seconds. On, it waits for the ✕ — and still only ever appears once.
settings.keyboardNote: Tab reaches every control. On the tree, the arrow keys move between limbs, Enter taps the one in focus and opens what it can grow, and Escape backs out one layer at a time.
settings.leafPatternsNote: Marks each species' foliage with its own pattern as well as its own green, so an oak still reads as an oak when the colours do not separate.
settings.motionNote: Your system asks for reduced motion, so the canopy is holding still and the drifting leaves are off. Numbers, colours and sound are unaffected.
settings.saveRefused: This browser is refusing to store the save — export a copy to keep it.
settings.soundNote: Every sound in the game is currently synthesised rather than recorded — placeholders until the real ones are made.
settings.title: Settings
storm.bracedBody: Braced to the last. The storm went through the canopy and took nothing.
storm.luckyBody: The wind found nothing to lever. It will not always be so generous.
storm.tookBody: What came down is yours: +{amount} Deadwood.
symbionts.maxed: At home here. Nothing more to give it.
symbionts.title: Symbionts
upgrades.title: Upgrades
vault.bondLocked: Buy Old Friend to choose a companion.
vault.bondPicked: {name} will be here from the first tick.
vault.bondReady: Who is waiting for you next run?
vault.forestEmpty: Nothing on the hills yet. Every tree you give up stands there for good, and each one adds {bonus}% to everything the next one makes.
vault.forestWorth: The grove is worth ×{multiplier} to all production. Latest: a {species} of {parts} parts.
vault.heirloomLocked: Buy the heirloom above this one first.
vault.offline: Offline the roots keep working for {hours} hours.
vault.payout: Going to seed now would pay {count} Seeds
vault.payoutOne: Going to seed now would pay 1 Seed
vault.remembered: The last tree is remembered — {parts} parts, waiting for a Memory heirloom to put them back.
vault.title: Seed Vault
vault.warning: The tree, its residents, its totems and everything it has earned are given up. Seeds, Heirlooms, Rings and the Journal are not.
weather.brace: — hold the trunk! Tap the anchor at the base.
workshop.emptySlot: Empty — carve a totem to plant one here
workshop.hint: Carved totems are permanent. Prune a limb (P) to make Deadwood.
workshop.title: Workshop
